Beware of the Fakes. After much used I definitely believe that the phone that I receive is a fake. I originally bought this phone for myself and it works great (especially the night pictures). Since I love the phone I decided to buy a second one for my wife. They look almost identical so I thought that it was the real thing. After complains of my wife that the frontal camera didn't focus as good as mine I started suspecting that my wife's phone is a fake. This was confirmed this weekend when we took night pictures in Las Vegas and the lights in her phone get extremely blurry while in my pictures taken with my phone work just like advertised. I'm really bum out that my wife have to deal with this. Please check the phones you buy carefully since the knockoffs are almost identical. Edit: Seller contacted me right away.
